messages:
anya: opened a quick design review for a new dark-theme iteration. renamed tokens + proposed chart palette. TL;DR: more contrast for axis/labels, warmer strings in code, colorblind-safe chart set.

samir: loading screenshots now. nice work! can you paste the token list?

anya: pasted in the PR diff. key tokens: --bg-900: #07080a, --panel-800: #0e1113, --text-primary: #e7eef6, --muted: #97a3aa, --accent: #6e9eff, --accent-strong: #5b86ff

leo: immediate nit: title headers on metric cards feel low-contrast at 13px. bump to 14px and increase weight or use text-primary.

aria: code block note: keyword vs variable color separation is subtle. proposal: keyword #b084ff, string #ffb66b, func/ident #7fb0ff. also add a slightly darker bg for inline code span to reduce glare.

max: accessibility check: I ran axe locally. two failures: chart axis labels (contrast ~3.6:1) and focus outline on flat buttons (hard to see on panels).

design-bot: visual-diff PR #517 generated: 6 images changed, 2 percy diffs flagged -> https://ci.internal/reports/517

anya: thanks. action items: 1) increase axis label contrast and size; 2) stronger focus ring (3px) with slightly desaturated accent; 3) swap chart palette to colorblind-friendly set (examples in thread).

samir: for charts I'd avoid saturated red/green pairs. suggested dark-aware palette: #8dd3c7, #bebada, #fb8072, #80b1d3, #fdb462. works well on black-ish bg.

leo: UX micro-thing: hover for thin sparkline should add a subtle outer glow instead of thickening line width. keeps default clean but helps discoverability.

aria: copy suggestion: in settings change toggle label from "Enable dark mode" -> "Dark theme" and tooltip: "Contrast-optimized for low-glare viewing". shorter and consistent with product language.

max: adding: token heatmap gradient should be sequential (teal->navy) for easier interpretation on simulators. I'll attach CVD sims after PR lands.

anya: updated PR: bumped header sizes, adjusted axis label color to text-primary, increased focus ring to 3px with rgba accent overlay, swapped chart palette, updated syntax tokens, changed toggle copy. pinged @max for sims.

design-bot: PR #517 updated by anya (branch/dusk-theme): CI status 3/3 checks started. visual-diff pending.

samir: quick screenshot pass looks promising. thanks for iterating fast.

leo: small follow-up after merge: can we add a lint rule to prevent token names like --accent-1, use semantic names instead (accent-action, accent-strong). helps future maintainability.

anya: good call. I'll add a docs snippet in the PR and a note in the styleguide. merging once visuals are green :thumbsup:
